requirements.title: University AI working competency
requirements.summary: Incoming Fall 2026 students must complete approved AI-focused coursework as a university core graduation requirement. Approved courses span one to four hours; the specific AI major course that fulfills this competency is not verified, so no additional credits are inferred.

notes: Official admissions h1 is Artificial Intelligence (Liberal Arts); its Quick Facts explicitly identifies the Bachelor of Arts award. Do not merge with the separate BS.
Admissions includes potentially inconsistent marketing language about coding; do not interpret it as a waiver of technical coursework.
Pilot record; institution ranking/cohort membership is established separately. Null fields indicate unverified facts, not absence.
The department plan summary establishes 24 philosophy credit hours and 15 CS credit hours. These are major components, not a verified degree total. Individual course credits are unstated.

The department summary lists CS 17600 as Introduction to Python and CS 24300 as AI Basics; the Fall 2026 CS directory instead uses Data Engineering In Python and Artificial Intelligence Basics. Source wording is preserved pending catalog reconciliation.
The full current catalog plan returned HTTP 403. Philosophy options, degree-wide requirements, grade/residency/overlap rules and catalog year remain unresolved.

CS 10100 content is summarized from registered source purdue-cs10100-canonical. Canonical outline, updated 2025-06-20; no current-term offering claim. Original course source supplies requirement identity/credits.

CS 18000 content is summarized from registered source purdue-cs180-canonical. Canonical outline, updated 2025-06-20; no current-term offering claim. Original course source supplies requirement identity/credits.

CS 18200 content and prerequisite is summarized from registered source purdue-cs182-canonical. Canonical outline, updated 2025-06-20; no current-term offering claim. Original course source supplies requirement identity/credits.

The CS 180 canonical outline uses the older heading Programming I; its source-linked directory course code matches CS 18000. CS 471 canonical material includes a 1998.08 date and was not used as current course evidence.

2026-10-10 continuation: department confirms eight philosophy courses but does not enumerate them. Advising and faculty plan pages contain no replacement AI plan. Linked CLA Core 21 PDF is a revised 2019 proposal and is not asserted as current Fall-2026 degree policy. Catalog access restriction remains unresolved.

The Fall 2026 Philosophy course directory was inspected on 2026-10-10. It lists offerings (including AI-related philosophy) but does not map the eight required AI-major philosophy courses or choice groups. No general philosophy offering was promoted to an AI BA requirement; the current catalog access denial remains a blocker. The linked undergraduate overview likewise supplies no alternate AI requirement inventory.
